newsitem.title: UK: IPE sets shortened trading hours for Monday.
newsitem.headline: IPE sets shortened trading hours for Monday.

text.p: The International Petroleum Exchange will observe shortened trading hours on Monday due to the Labour Day holiday in the United States.
Brent crude oil futures and options will cease trading at 1630 GMT, from its normal closing time of 1915 GMT, an IPE spokeswoman said.
Gas oil futures and options will close at their normal time of 1627 GMT.
The New York Mercantile Exchange is closed on Monday.
